title: Polynomial-time computability of visit rows
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over Booleans and natural numbers $C,e$, the function sending a Boolean request to its visit row is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
replaced: For every source machine and certificate parameters $C$ and $e$, the function sending a retained-instance and unary-time request to the packed row of last-visit codes for all work tapes is polynomial-time computable: native projections recover the instance and time, exact preparation builds the reference input, each tape's search is native, and finite pairing charges the whole ordered row.
